title: Replication code and derived data: Seafood traceability in Oman's export supply chains (book chapter)
description: Python pipeline, input snapshots and derived outputs that reproduce every table, figure and statistic in the book chapter 'Seafood Traceability in an Emerging Economy: A Multi-Layer Framework for Food Safety, Sustainability, and Regulatory Compliance in Oman's Export Supply Chains'. Includes a verification script that compares the figures reported in the chapter with the pipeline outputs. Code is released under the MIT licence. Derived data in outputs/ are released under CC BY 4.0. The raw workbooks are not redistributed.
